title: Italian Beef Piadina Rolls
description: A keto Italian-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked beef in a crispy piadina roll.
instructions: Slice the beef into thin strips and season with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, heat the Italian seasonings over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the beef to a slow cooker and add 1 cup of beef broth.
Cook on low for 2-3 hours or until tender.
Meanwhile, roll out the piadina into thin sheets.
Slice the cooked beef into thin strips.
Assemble the rolls by placing a few strips of beef onto each sheet of piadina.
Roll up the piadina and serve garnished with chopped kidney and a sprinkle of zesty seasonings.
